messages:
Sarah: Quick heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2787 is ready but the cost-breakdown dashboard snippet fails for SDK users on 0.7+. It errors on the tracing import.
Jordan: Saw that, thanks. We renamed runtime_tracing -> tracing.hooks in 0.7.1 and updated the tracer init signature.
Leo: Can we keep the old import aliased in the snippet with a short migration note? Docs should show both v0.6 and v0.7 usage so customers can patch quickly.
Sarah: That's what I was thinking. Also CI flagged snippet-check (snippet linter) — deploy-bot posted an error in the PR checks.
deploy-bot: snippet-check failed — TraceImportError in examples/cost_breakdown.md: 'from runtime_tracing import Tracer' not found (SDK v0.7).
Ivan: I can update the PR with a dual-snippet and a one-line migration paragraph. Proposed snippets below — please sanity-check.
Ivan: ```python
# SDK v0.6 (existing customers)
from runtime_tracing import Tracer
tracer = Tracer(service="console")
tracer.attach_to(flask_app)
```
Ivan: ```python
# SDK v0.7+ (newer installs)
from tracing.hooks import Tracer
tracer = Tracer(service="console", enabled=True)
tracer.init_app(flask_app)
```
Jordan: That looks good. Add a short sentence: "If you upgraded from 0.6 to 0.7+, replace runtime_tracing imports with tracing.hooks and use init_app instead of attach_to — see SDK changelog." Link to changelog in PR description.
Leo: Also run the snippet linter locally before pushing: `./scripts/snippet-lint.sh docs/cost_breakdown.md` — it catches import errors.
Sarah: Updated the PR text and added the changelog link. Pushed the dual-snippet, CI re-run.
deploy-bot: CI snippet-check rerun — OK :white_check_mark: (all examples validated)
Sarah: Awesome, thanks everyone. I'll merge once the docs build finishes. :tada:
